name: squish-memory
description: Local-first memory runtime for AI agents via MCP. Provides 7 tools for durable memory, recall, graph linking, context, and inspection.

tools.name: squish_remember
tools.description: Store any memory or learning. System auto-detects type and routes appropriately.

tools.name: squish_recall
tools.description: Recall memories by query, or retrieve a specific memory by ID.

tools.name: squish_forget
tools.description: Delete a memory by ID, or bulk delete with search filters.

tools.name: squish_link
tools.description: Manage memory associations: find related memories or add links between them.

tools.name: squish_context
tools.description: Get project context or list registered projects.

tools.name: squish_stats
tools.description: Get memory statistics and system health for a project.

tools.name: squish_inspect
tools.description: Explain why a memory was retained, where it was routed, and whether raw fallback exists.
